SUMMARY\nFuwaStream has no accounts, servers, ads or trackers. All the data you create in this app is stored on your own device and is never sent to us.

DATA STORED ON YOUR DEVICE
• Watch history with episode position and duration (for "Continue Watching").
• Your list of favorite anime.
• Search history (last 12 entries at most).
• App settings: theme, video quality, download quality, player options.
• Episode files you download to watch offline.
This data is kept in a local database and the app's private storage. None of it is sent to the developer.

DATA WE DO NOT COLLECT
• No accounts, emails, phone numbers or usernames.
• No analytics, behavior tracking, ads or third-party SDKs that build profiles.
• No automatic crash reports (crash reporter). If the app closes by itself, no data is sent anywhere.
• No cookies. This app is not a browser and does not load web pages.

CONNECTIONS TO THIRD-PARTY SERVICES
To show content, the app connects directly from your device to:
• xyz-api.animein.net — anime catalog, release schedule, posters and video stream links.
• api.github.com — checking for new app versions.
When connecting, your device's IP address and User-Agent are technically visible to those services, as with any internet connection. We do not receive, store or sell that data. Use of third-party services is subject to each service's own privacy policy.

APP PERMISSIONS
• INTERNET — loading the catalog and playing video. Required.
• ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE — detecting Wi-Fi versus mobile data for video quality and the "download on Wi-Fi only" rule. Required.
• POST_NOTIFICATIONS — new episode notifications and download progress. Optional; it can be denied without affecting other features.

DEVICE BACKUP\nIf Android automatic backup is enabled on your device, the app\'s local data (favorites, history, settings) may be backed up by Google\'s backup service according to your device settings. That backup is managed by the operating system, not by this app.
CHILDREN\nThe app is intended for users aged 13 and over. We do not knowingly collect data from children under 13, and we do not collect personal data from anyone at all.
SECURITY\nData is kept in the app\'s private storage, protected by the Android sandbox. No personal data is transmitted to our servers because we have no servers.

YOUR RIGHTS AND DATA DELETION\nYou can delete your data at any time right in the app: Settings → Data → Delete all data. This permanently removes favorites, watch history, search history, settings and downloaded files from the device. Uninstalling the app also removes all of its data.
POLICY CHANGES\nChanges to this policy will be released with a new app version and recorded in the public repository: github.com/fuwanime/fuwastream.
CONTACT\nPrivacy questions: fuwanimereal@gmail.com

CONTENT\nThe catalog, posters, thumbnails and video links are loaded while the app runs from a third-party service (animein.net). The app includes no stock images, music or paid assets. The app icon was made for this project and is released with the code under GPL-3.0. Rights to posters and thumbnails remain with their respective owners and are shown only as catalog references.
AFFILIATION\nFuwaStream is an independent community project. It is not affiliated with any content provider or with the copyright holders of the anime shown.
